# @opensourceframework/turn-based-game-engine

Framework-agnostic TypeScript game engine primitives extracted from tarkuv.

Public API:
- `processTick`, `calculateOfflineProgress`, `processRaidExtraction`, `processPlayerDeath`
- item, map, enemy, encounter, quest, trader, recipe, skill, and RNG utilities
- serializable TypeScript types for game state, raids, inventory, quests, and hideout systems

The deterministic RNG is for games and simulations, not cryptographic use.
